# Dracula GTK v4.0.0 base CSS

Pristine generated CSS from:

https://github.com/dracula/gtk/tree/v4.0.0

These files are vendored as the immutable base for the BakaBot palette pass.
`tools/build.sh` copies them into the theme, applies structural fixes, then
applies the BakaBot palette.

Do not edit these files directly. Upstream licensing and attribution are in
the repository root (`LICENSE`, `NOTICE`, `AUTHORS`).
